# skycloak_login_branding (Resource)

Login-page branding for a realm (a singleton; create == update upsert).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_login_branding" "app" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name

  primary_color    = "#0ea5e9"
  background_color = "#0f172a"
  logo_url         = "https://cdn.example.com/logo.png"

  registration_enabled    = true
  forgot_password_enabled = true
  show_powered_by         = false

  internationalization = {
    enabled                    = true
    default_locale             = "en"
    supported_locales          = ["en", "fr"]
    language_selection_mode    = "automatic_with_selector"
    language_selector_position = "top_right"
    language_selector_style    = "dropdown"
  }

  sso = {
    enabled       = true
    button_size   = "medium"
    display_style = "logo_with_text"
    layout        = "horizontal"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `background_color` (String) Login page background color (hex).
- `favicon_url` (String) URL of the browser favicon.
- `font_url` (String) URL of a custom web font.
- `forgot_password_enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to the API's value when unset.
- `internationalization` (Attributes) Login page internationalization settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--internationalization))
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo displayed on the login page.
- `primary_color` (String) Primary accent color applied to buttons (hex, e.g. `#0ea5e9`).
- `privacy_policy_url` (String) URL of the privacy policy linked in the footer.
- `registration_enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to the API's value when unset.
- `remember_me_enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to the API's value when unset.
- `show_powered_by` (Boolean) Defaults to the API's value when unset.
- `sso` (Attributes) Identity-provider button display on the login page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sso))
- `terms_of_service_url` (String) URL of the terms of service linked in the footer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/login_branding`.
- `status` (String) Deployment status (`applied`, `applying`, `failed`).

<a id="nestedatt--internationalization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `internationalization`

Required:

- `default_locale` (String) Default locale (BCP 47 tag, e.g. `en`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether internationalization is enabled.
- `language_selection_mode` (String) `automatic_only`, `automatic_with_selector`, `hide_selector`, or `selector_only`.
- `language_selector_position` (String) `form_inside_header`, `form_inside_left`, `top_left`, `top_middle`, or `top_right`.
- `language_selector_style` (String) `dropdown`, `flags`, or `text_labels`.
- `supported_locales` (List of String) Locales available to users. Must include `default_locale`.


<a id="nestedatt--sso"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sso`

Required:

- `button_size` (String) `small`, `medium`, or `large`.
- `display_style` (String) `logo_only`, `logo_with_text`, or `text_only`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Show identity provider buttons on the login page.
- `layout` (String) `horizontal` or `vertical`.
